commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: - Verified: `npx vitest run` (208 tests), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), and `npm run build:check` (existing Vite site, unaffected) all still pass after these changes.

- **`astro check`/TypeScript 7 blocker — RESOLVED.** User approved downgrading TypeScript project-wide (option 2 from the three listed above). Downgraded `typescript` `7.0.2` → `6.0.3` (exact pin, latest stable 6.x) and reinstalled `@astrojs/check@^0.9.9` (clean install this time, no `--legacy-peer-deps` needed — peer range `^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0` now satisfied). `astro check` runs successfully: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 1 pre-existing hint (`CSSProperties` deprecation in `src/explainers/fourier.tsx`, unrelated to this migration, not fixed). Re-verified `tsc --noEmit`, `npx vitest run` (208 tests), and `npm run build:check` all still pass under TS 6.0.3. `package.json` scripts not yet updated to include an `astro check` step — still deferred to Phase 9/10 alongside the `vite.config.ts` deletion/script cutover, per the Phase 1 deviation noted above.
- Next: Phase 2 (content collections) — `src/content/config.ts`, frontmatter codemod across the 18 `docs/algorithms/*.md` files (including `stochastic-hill.md`), one placeholder blog post.

- **Plan correction**: the content collections config must live at `src/content.config.ts` (project root), not `src/content/config.ts` as the approved plan said — Astro 7 (since Astro 6) rejects the old location with a `LegacyContentConfigError`. Moved it during implementation.

- Wrote a one-off `scripts/codemod-add-frontmatter.mjs` (deleted after running, per its own header note) that added real YAML frontmatter (`id`, `name`, `typeBadge`, `description`, `hasExplainer`) to all 18 `docs/algorithms/*.md` files, reusing `build-docs.mjs`'s extraction regexes as a starting point — but fixed two real bugs found while reviewing the output rather than reproducing them into permanent content:

1. The original 250-char hard truncation cut several descriptions mid-word (e.g. "fresh rand", "gravitational co"). Fine when it only fed an invisible `<meta>` tag; not fine baked into permanent frontmatter. Replaced with sentence-boundary-aware truncation (falls back to word-boundary + "…" only if no sentence break exists in range).

2. The description-section regex used `/m` for `^## Description`, which also makes `$` match end-of-*line* (not end-of-string) — silently truncating any description whose first paragraph soft-wraps across multiple source lines (hit `fourier.md` and `som.md`). Fixed with `(?![\s\S])` as an explicit end-of-string assertion.
3. Also fixed: single-asterisk `*italic*` markdown wasn't stripped (only `**bold**` was), leaving stray asterisks in `or-opt.md`/`tabu-search.md` descriptions.
- `stochastic_hill` classified under the "Local search" group (matches its own doc's `**Type**: Heuristic — local search` badge).

- Created `src/content.config.ts` with `docs` (glob loader → `../docs/algorithms`, matching the plan) and `blog` (glob loader → `./src/content/blog`) collections, both Zod-validated. Added one placeholder post `src/content/blog/welcome.md` (`draft: true`) to prove the collection end-to-end.

- **New tsconfig conflict found and fixed**: adding `src/content.config.ts` broke the still-live Vite pipeline's plain `tsc` step — `astro:content` is a virtual module whose types only exist via Astro's own sync/build process, which plain `tsc` doesn't know about. Added an `exclude` list to `tsconfig.json` (`src/content.config.ts`, `src/content/**`, `src/pages/**`, `src/layouts/**`, `src/components/**`) so the legacy `tsc`-based pipeline ignores Astro-only files, while `astro check` (which maintains its own project understanding regardless of the root tsconfig's exclude list) still fully validates them. Verified both stay green independently.

- Verified end-to-end via a throwaway spike page (`getCollection('docs')`/`getCollection('blog')`, built and inspected the static HTML output, then deleted): 18 docs resolved with correct `id`s, exactly 10 flagged `hasExplainer: true` (matching `EXPLAINER_SOLVERS`), 1 blog post resolved with the right title. `npx astro sync`, `npx astro check` (0 errors), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests), and `npm run build:check` (existing Vite site) all pass.

- Note: running `npm run build:check` for verification regenerated the committed `teeline-web/algorithms/<id>/index.html` files (pre-existing generated output that's checked into git) with cosmetic diffs from the new frontmatter shifting `extractMeta()`'s output slightly — reverted those via `git checkout` since they were an incidental verification byproduct, not intended Phase 2 changes. Worth remembering for future verification runs on this branch.

- Next: Phase 3 (static content pages) — `BaseLayout.astro`, `Topbar.astro`, `AlgorithmCards.astro`, `FeatureCards.astro`, then `index.astro`, `tsp/`, `webmcp/`, `api-key/`. This is also where Astro 7's stricter markup validation risk first surfaces.

commit.message:
Log Phase 2 (content collections) completion for Astro migration

Content config location corrected (src/content.config.ts, not
src/content/config.ts — Astro 7 rejects the old location). Frontmatter
codemod for 18 docs/algorithms/*.md files, fixing 3 real bugs found
along the way (mid-word truncation, /m-flag $ matching end-of-line,
unstripped single-asterisk italics) rather than reproducing them into
permanent content. tsconfig.json exclude added to keep the legacy
tsc-based build pipeline from breaking on astro:content virtual
module types. Verified end-to-end via throwaway spike page.

Implements [[tasks/teeline-web-astro7-migration]]
